1	/**
2	 * ContainerExecutor — delegates command execution to a Cloudflare Container.
3	 *
4	 * Cloudflare Containers (beta as of 2025) allow Workers to launch and
5	 * communicate with Docker-compatible containers via a service binding
6	 * (`Fetcher`). The container runs the adapter plugin process and exposes
7	 * the same HTTP API as the sandbox bridge: `POST /execute` and
8	 * `POST /cancel/:runId`.
9	 *
10	 * This executor is opt-in. Set `cloudflare.adapter_executor = "container"`
11	 * in the deployment config to use it instead of the default sandbox bridge.
12	 *
13	 * Container binding declaration in `wrangler.toml` (add when enabling):
14	 * ```toml
15	 * [[containers]]
16	 * binding = "PLUGIN_CONTAINER"
17	 * image = "ghcr.io/paperclipai/plugin-sandbox:latest"
18	 * ```
19	 *
20	 * The container image must expose `POST /execute` and `POST /cancel/:runId`
21	 * on port 80 (default for CF container bindings).
22	 *
23	 * Reference: https://developers.cloudflare.com/containers/
24	 */
25	
26	import type { CommandExecutorInput, RunProcessResult } from "./sandbox-bridge.js";
27	
28	/**
29	 * Creates an executor that delegates command execution to a Cloudflare
30	 * Container service binding.
31	 *
32	 * @param containerBinding - The `Fetcher` injected by the Workers runtime
33	 *   for the container service binding declared in `wrangler.toml`.
34	 */
35	export function createContainerExecutor(containerBinding: Fetcher) {
36	  return {
37	    /**
38	     * Execute a command inside the container.
39	     *
40	     * The container receives the same wire-format body as the sandbox bridge
41	     * so both executors are interchangeable from the caller's perspective.
42	     */
43	    async run(input: CommandExecutorInput): Promise<RunProcessResult> {
44	      // `onLog` is stripped from the wire body — same pattern as
45	      // sandbox-bridge.ts.
46	      const { onLog, ...wireBody } = input;
47	
48	      const resp = await containerBinding.fetch("http://container/execute", {
49	        method: "POST",
50	        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
51	        body: JSON.stringify(wireBody),
52	      });
53	
54	      if (!resp.ok) {
55	        const text = await resp.text().catch(() => "(unreadable)");
56	        throw new Error(`Container executor /execute returned HTTP ${resp.status}: ${text}`);
57	      }
58	
59	      const result = (await resp.json()) as RunProcessResult;
